Introduction

Keena is a South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and composer under ATTRAKT. She is best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY. She officially debuted with the group on November 18, 2022, with the release of their mini album “The Fifty”.

In a video from Genie Music Youtube channel, published on September 30, 2024, Keena revealed that she had legally changed her name from Song Jakyung to Song Yuni.
